notes: Real Keycloak authorization-code PKCE against two API replicas. 200 distinct identities resolved to 200 unique principals carrying organization pilot and project default, each denied a mutation server-side as a viewer. The first run failed on a null organization claim: the rehearsal launcher aborted on a PowerShell stderr artifact after docker compose up, so the kcadm step registering organization_id and project_ids as tenant attributes never ran. The product behaved correctly throughout and the assertion caught a half-configured environment; both runs are part of this gate's record.
